definitions.explanation: A division of the academic year.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{学期|がっき}が{始|はじ}まりました。
1{学期|がっき}の{成績|せいせき}は{良|よ}かったです。
examples.english: My grades for the first term were good.

examples.japanese: {学期|がっき}の{終|お}わりに{試験|しけん}があります。
examples.english: There are exams at the end of the term.

notes: Most Japanese schools use a three-term system: 1学期 (April-July), 2学期 (September-December), and 3学期 (January-March). The school year starts in April. Some schools use a two-semester system (前期 and 後期).
